description: This source file defines the WatchConnectivityReceiver class responsible for handling communication between an iOS app and a paired Apple Watch using WatchConnectivity framework. It includes data structures for message drafts and results, manages WCSession activation, and processes received messages and user info.

classes.name: WatchConnectivityReceiver
classes.description: Manages the WatchConnectivity session, activates it, sends messages, and handles receiving messages and user info from Apple Watch.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates the WCSession if supported, setting itself as delegate.

methods.name: ensureActivated
methods.description: Ensures the session is activated, retrying activation if needed.

methods.name: sendReply
methods.description: Sends a reply message to the watch, either via sendMessage if reachable or transferUserInfo if not.

methods.name: session(_: didReceiveMessage:replyHandler:)
methods.description: Handles incoming messages expecting a reply.
